newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nakamichi to issue 6.26 mln shares to two banks.
newsitem.headline: Nakamichi to issue 6.26 mln shares to two banks.

text.p: Car audio equipment maker Nakamichi Corp said on Friday that it would issue a total of 6.26 million shares worth 3.10 billion yen to Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd and Fuji Bank Ltd.
The payment date is set for February 17, Nakamichi said in a statement.
Nakamichi will allocate 3.13 million new shares to each bank, Nakamichi said.
Nakamichi decided to issue new shares to the two banks, with which the company has close ties, in order to strengthen its financial health, the company said.
The funds raised through the new share issue will be used for its business operations, the company said without elaborating.
As a result of the issue, Nakamichi's outstanding shares will total 97.24 million shares.
Nakamichi officials were not immediately available for further comment.

Nakamichi said last November it would allocate 64 million new shares to a Singapore unit of Hong Kong's Grande Holdings Ltd in January. Nakamichi said at that time that, as a result of the issue, the Grande group would own a 70.3 percent stake in Nakamichi.
Nakamichi's statement on Friday said that the share issue to the Grande group was completed on January 16.
